title: NativeDiff.v1
description: The auditable record of every VERIFIED value change a schema_preserving projection applied to the native output. The original is never overwritten — the diff is what makes a same-schema value change (e.g. '30 days' -> '10 business days') reversible and accountable. Each changed field carries its path, old_value, new_value, the decision, and a receipt_id: a value may change ONLY when verified, and NO change is allowed without a receipt. An empty changed_fields array is the normal case for passthrough/sidecar modes (nothing was altered). Lossless distillation: old_value is preserved here, never erased.
